Rooftop Units, Food Service .............................................................. 38 U.S.DepartmentofEnergy | OfficeofEnergyEfficiency&RenewableEnergy x UnderstandingCommercialBuildingEnergyUseintheGreaterMemphisArea: BuildingStock SegmentationforRetrofitPlanning 1 Overview This report is part of the second phase of a series of publications focusing on approx- imately 100 different local geographies, or “clusters.” Each report provides character- istic features and energy data for commercial buildings in a specific area to help policy makers at the city, county, and state level better understand building energy use and emissions. This report breaks down the energy consumption and emissions of the build- ing stock in the Greater Memphis Area counties, as shown in Figure 2, by building type, building size, end use, energy consumption, emissions, and segment.
